programme.title: Jaque Mate
programme.desc: David Hernández, conocido por ser el presentador del exitoso programa ficticio de juegos "Jaque Mate", se ve repentinamente sumergido en una pesadilla cuando recibe una llamada anónima durante una transmisión en vivo. El desconocido le informa que su hijo y esposa han sido secuestrados y que su vida depende de seguir las instrucciones que le dará en el programa. Aterrorizado y bajo la presión del secuestrador, David se ve obligado a convertir su programa en un escenario para cumplir con las demandas del criminal. Mientras la audiencia mira atónita, David debe resolver acertijos y desafíos en tiempo real para garantizar la seguridad de su familia. La tensión aumenta a medida que cada movimiento en el juego televisivo podría significar la diferencia entre la vida y la muerte para sus seres queridos. Determinado y enfrentando peligros desconocidos, David se embarca en una incansable búsqueda para reunir a su familia sana y salva, desafiando todo lo que le rodea para lograr su objetivo.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: David sale con Lola pero, en realidad, está enamorado de Marina, la amiga de Lola. Por eso, prepara una cena y le pide a López que se líe con Lola, pero éste es un despistado y se pasa toda la noche confundiéndolas.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: David y Marina ya salen juntos y están muy enamorados. Los amigos de David no entienden esta relación (Marina es tan interesante...).

programme.desc: Stasky amplia las posibilidades del bar ofreciendo un servicio a domicilio. Emma se ofrece a llevar un pedido al Museo de cera pero, las horas pasan, y no regresa. David y Stasky van a buscarla.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: Para librarse de una multa, Emma dice que es la novia de Ángel, el guardia. Pero Ángel se entera de su mentira y decide que va a pagárselas todas juntas.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: Emma no sabe como decirle a Ángel que no quiere casarse con él. David y López tampoco creen que el matrimonio funcione. Quieren convencer a Emma de que no se case pero ella les dice que no se preocupen, que todo está controlado.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: Emma y López llevan a Marujito a un concurso de canto de canarios porque están convencidos de que puede convertirse en una gran estrella.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: Pol regresa a Barcelona por unos días y David está muy emocionado. Pero, al reencontrarse, se dan cuenta de que su relación de amistad ya no es como antes.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: López conoce a Guillermina en un chat y se enamora. Pero, por culpa de una casualidad, Guillermina confunde a López con David y David decide no sacarla de su error.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: Ahora que López y Guillermina son novios, nunca encuentran ni el momento ni el lugar para tener un poco de intimidad.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: López tiene planeado un fantástico fin de semana con Guillermina pero todos apuestan que no serán capaces de aguantar tantas horas juntos.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: López se quiere casar con Guillermina y se va a Finlandia a pedir los papeles del divorcio a Diana. Allí se despierta algo en su interior a ritmo de salsa.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: Mientras López está en Finlandia, David y Guillermina se lían. A su regreso, David está muy extraño. Los remordimientos no le dejan vivir.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: Josep López es locutor de radio en una emisora local. A sus treinta y cuatro años se da cuenta de que debe independizarse y empieza a buscarse un piso.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: David y López se enteran de que a Emma le dan miedo las películas de terror y deciden aprovecharse. Esa noche, Emma va a quedarse a dormir en su piso y ellos traman un plan para hacer un trío con ella creyendo que ella aceptará a la primera.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: Un nuevo becario llega a la radio en la que trabaja López. Es un chico que no acaba de funcionar; López intenta ayudarle pero lo único que consigue es que el chico se aproveche de él.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: López quiere celebrar su cumpleaños con una gran fiesta pero David cree que ya es demasiado viejo para esas cosas.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: Pol, que está absolutamente convencido de ser homosexual, se enrolla con Emma y supone que no por eso dejará de serlo.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: Oriol, el padre hippy de López, se presenta en casa de su hijo y decide instalarse unos días. David queda realmente impresionado con Oriol, sería genial tener un padre así.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: Ariadna, la hija de Mercedes, se enamora de López, que también queda prendado de ella. David le acusa de infanticida.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: David recibe una carta del Ministerio de Defensa conforme debe ir a la mili. David pide a López que le espere y cuando regrese seguirán siendo compañeros de piso.

programme.desc: López queda para cenar con Ramón y con su mujer, Rosa. Durante la cena, Rosa no le dirige la palabra pero, a espaldas de Ramón, le tira los tejos.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: Pol descubre que Emma está enamorada de López y les prepara una cita a través de un anónimo.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: David descubre que su madre tiene un amante y decide contárselo a su padre pero no sabe por donde empezar.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: López alquila una plaza de parking. Él no tiene ni coche ni carnet de conducir pero ese parece un buen sistema para planteárselo en serio e intentar sacárselo.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: David y López se han enamorado de Emma. Ninguno dejará que el otro la vea a solas y saque ventaja. Carbonell intenta vender a todo el mundo un viaje organizado por ella.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: Carbonell, Ramón, Pol y Mercedes regresan del viaje. Ramón no para de contar que Pol le salvó la vida y que siempre estará en deuda con él.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: Emma se ha ido. López y David están hechos polvo tras su marcha. Al enterarse de que el administrador del bloque busca un nuevo inquilino para la casita de madera, David y López salen desesperadamente en busca de Emma.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: David y López no saben qué hacer con un paquete de droga que les ha llegado por error. Si lo venden, pueden sacar mucho dinero pero si les pillan... aunque quizás deberían preocuparse por si su dueño lo reclama.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: Emma quiere pedir el paro pero allí la convocan a un cursillo y debe pasar un examen. Carbonell y Mercedes le echarán una mano para que apruebe.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: Mercedes intenta hablar de un tema importante con López, que la esquiva constantemente por miedo a que le eche una bronca.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: Mercedes decide darse un tiempo de reflexión y descanso después de su ruptura sentimental. Se va de la radio y nombra a López nuevo director.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: Pol decide sacar más partido del bar Mauricio y prepara varias actuaciones que sirvan de reclamo para ganar clientes. David prepara una actuación que muestre sus grandes dotes interpretativas.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: David decide montar una fiesta para celebrar la noche de Halloween. López, mucho más tradicional, prefiere celebrar la castañada.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: La exnovia de López regresa a Barcelona para verle y para proponerle que engendre a su hijo ya que quiere ser madre soltera.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: Carbonell lleva a casa un gato que pertenece a un "capo" mafioso, al que le debe un favor. Deberá cuidarlo durante el fin de semana.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: David está resfriado y decide llamar al médico de la Seguridad Social.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: Pol, López y David leen en el periódico que un asesino anda suelto por su barrio.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: Carbonell conoce a un hombre en una discoteca y empiezan a bailar muy compenetrados.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: El reencuentro entre Oriol y Carbonell desencadena la prisa de López y David por llevar a la pareja hasta el altar, no sin antes celebrar las respectivas despedidas de soltero.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: ¡Qué bonita es la Navidad! El pesebre, el árbol, los regalos, los villancicos, la familia... y las peleas.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: En este capítulo se descubre quienes son "realmente" los actores que dan vida a los personajes de la serie. Asistimos a la representación de lo que es una grabación en plató de uno de los capítulos y podemos ver a David haciendo de Joel Joan, a López haciendo de Jordi Sánchez, etc.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: Desde que Carbonell se casó y se fue a vivir a Porrera con Oriol, David no da una. Acostumbrado a que se lo hicieran todo, ahora tiene que espabilarse solo y no se le da muy bien.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: López es un desastre como asistenta así que David decide organizar un "casting" para encontrar a alguien que sea competente.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: Carbonell se separa de Oriol y regresa al piso de López y David. Éstos descubren casualmente que Oriol es propietario de muchas tierras y fuerzan el divorcio de Carbonell y Oriol a fin de sacar tajada de la ruptura.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: David recibe la llamada de un productor convocándole a un casting en Madrid. Él sabe que es una gran oportunidad para su carrera de actor.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: Emma presenta una amiga suya, Lola, a David y éste se queda embobado. Con la ayuda de Carbonell monta una fiesta en el piso para poder invitarla. Por otro lado, a López le cae un "encargo" de sus jefes de la radio: hacer de canguro de su hijo. La fiesta será el punto de encuentro para sorpresa de uno y enfado del otro.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: David sale con Lola pero, en realidad, está enamorado de Marina, la amiga de Lola. Por eso, prepara una cena y le pide a López que se líe con Lola, pero éste es un despistado y se pasa toda la noche confundiéndolas.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: David y Marina ya salen juntos y están muy enamorados. Los amigos de David no entienden esta relación (Marina es tan interesante...).

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: López se encuentra casualmente con un antiguo amigo que ahora es manager musical. Para recordar los viejos tiempos, éste le propone relanzar su carrera de "rumbero" juvenil.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: Marina quiere que David la acompañe a una expedición científica en alta mar. David, no sabe nadar pero se lo calla y se une a la expedición para no desilusionarla.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: "Radio Bofarull" esta a punto de cerrar por falta de audiencia. Ramón tiene una idea para salvarla: escribe un guión radiofónico sobre una fuga en la central nuclear.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: David descubre que, para triunfar como actor, se necesita algo más que vocación. Se debe estar muy preparado. Por eso decide apuntarse a todo tipo de cursillos.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: Lidia, exnovia de López, regresa embarazada del Amazonas y está a punto de dar a luz. Poco a poco, López se va implicando en los preparativos del parto bajo la mirada crítica de David.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: López está emocionadísimo por su recién estrenada paternidad pero Lidia le comunica que se va a Brasil con la niña. David le monta una gran fiesta de despedida. Por fin las cosas regresarán a la normalidad.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: Llega al Instituto del Treatro un nuevo profesor extranjero. Sus peculiares métodos crean polémica entre sus alumnos hasta el punto que Pol decide enfrentarse a él. David, en cambio, está encantado con sus clases.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: A López y a David les han embargado el piso por culpa de un crédito que López pidió para su padre y que éste no le devuelve.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: David se queda encerrado en el lavabo. Carbonell intenta abrir la puerta pero es imposible; el inquilino anterior montó allí un refugio nuclear.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: David toma conciencia de la degradación del medio ambiente y decide hacerse ecologista.

programme.title: Platos Sucios

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: La abuela de David se presenta por sorpresa y asegura que ha notado que está a punto de morirse y quiere que eso ocurra en casa de su nieto.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: La abuela Sunción aún vive en otra época. No entiende lo que significa vivir juntos sin estar casados o que dos amigos compartan piso para pagar el alquiler.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: Quim Monzó pide a López que le escriba su próxima novela. Nadie debe enterarse. David quiere estrenarse como director de cine y empieza a preparar una película.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: López se va de viaje a Cuba y regresa con una cubana. Está decidido a casarse con ella para que obtenga la nacionalidad española pero David se enamora perdidamente de ella. Los dos acabarán peleándose para acompañarla al altar.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: Una compañía de teatro alternativo contrata a David como actor. Empiezan a tener problemas cuando les niegan la subvención que habían pedido y no saben de donde sacar el dinero para acabar de montar el espectáculo.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: David y López son un par de pesimistas y deciden espabilar a Emma porque creen que vive en un mundo feliz e irreal.

programme.title: Platos Sucios

programme.title: Platos Sucios

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: López regresa a la universidad para conseguir el título de licenciado. Allí comprueba que los estudiantes de ahora no tienen nada que ver con los de su época.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: Mientras ve una película, David tiene una revelación mística y creer que es Jesucristo. Vestido de Jesucristo, acaba convenciendo a todos sus amigos. Su primer milagro es la multiplicación del donut.

programme.title: Platos Sucios

Cuando los fuertes vientos brinden la ventana meteorológica tan esperada.

programme.desc: La tripulación de Turquía hace el salto crítico sobre el Atlántico Norte. Pero en el camino a Portugal, un equipo se ve obligado a regresar. Sin potencia en un motor y sin forma de mantener la altitud, deben regresar a Santa María, donde el aeropuerto está en alerta de emergencia completa. Y Mikey y Scott buscan una nueva rampie, mientras que las esperanzas de Jeremy se desploman aún más.

programme.title: Memoria Negra
programme.desc: Año 2010. En la isla de Menorca se hallan los restos momificados de un niño en el interior de una maleta. Tras una complicada investigación, el grupo de homicidios de la Policía Nacional logra establecer la identidad de la víctima, César, y localizar a su asesina, Mónica Juanatey, su madre.

programme.title: Wives With Knives (español)
programme.desc: Crystal Johnson ansía amor, pero su paranoia y su inclinación por la violencia son profundas y la llevan a explotar.

programme.title: Wives With Knives (español)
programme.desc: Carol Singh emigra a Nueva York desde Surinam con la esperanza de alcanzar el sueño americano, que incluye casarse.

programme.title: Wives With Knives (español)
programme.desc: Después de una exitosa carrera como contrabandista de cocaína en el glamoroso Fort Lauderdale de los años 80, Donna Buchanan se involucra con un hombre mayor llamado Charlie.

programme.title: Wives With Knives (español)
programme.desc: Diane se enamora del carismático político Joe Reilly, pero tan pronto como dicen "Sí, acepto", Joe revela su tirano abusivo interior.

programme.title: Memoria Negra
programme.desc: Año 1987. La aparición del cadáver de ciudadano alemán Winfred Brandt inicia una investigación que llevará a la resolución del misterioso caso de los restos humanos aparecidos en dos playas de la isla de Mallorca. Unas muertes relacionadas entre sí y que esconden múltiples incógnitas.

programme.title: Memoria Negra
programme.desc: Noviembre del año 1997. Manfred Meisel, el llamado Rey de la Cerveza, es asesinado en su domicilio junto a su hijo Patrick, de ocho años, y Claudia Leinsten, una empleada del empresario alemán. Un triple asesinato sin resolver, ejecutado por sicarios y envuelto en múltiples incógnitas.

programme.title: Memoria Negra
programme.desc: Noura Hitchou es asesinada a plena luz del día al regresar a casa tras finalizar su jornada laboral. Tres días después es detenido Rachid Bennis, su ex-pareja, como culpable del crimen. El homicida había permanecido oculto junto con uno de los hijos que tenía en común con la víctima al que había secuestrado.

programme.title: Memoria Negra
programme.desc: El 11 de enero de 1977 María Dolores Santiago Palenzuela desaparece sin dejar rastro. 29 años después el caso sería resuelto tras el hallazgo de sus restos, enterrados en el sótano de un hotel de Palma que se encontraba en obras.

programme.title: Wives With Knives (español)
programme.desc: Después de ser irrespetada y engañada por hombres, Edna Wilson decide enfocarse en su carrera y su familia.

programme.title: Wives With Knives (español)
programme.desc: Después de tres matrimonios que terminan en adicción y divorcio, Debra Hudson se dedica a ayudar a otros a través del asesoramiento y el trabajo social.

programme.title: Wives With Knives (español)
programme.desc: Terri Pearson es una mujer transgénero que se ve obligada a sobrevivir en las calles.

programme.title: Wives With Knives (español)
programme.desc: Karen Miller emprende un romance en un viaje por carretera con un hombre mayor, pero lo deja después de quedar embarazada y regresa a Arizona.

programme.title: Wives With Knives (español)
programme.desc: Los adolescentes Tamara y Leo se ven obligados a casarse cuando Tamara queda embarazada, pero la presión de criar una familia los separa.

programme.desc: El 21 de diciembre de 1997, el cadáver de una joven de 21 años es hallado en un terreno baldío de Perpiñán. La víctima, Moktaria Chaïb, presenta mutilaciones espantosas.

programme.title: Contra Reloj
programme.desc: En los serenos bosques de Brunehaut, Bélgica, el triste descubrimiento del cuerpo sin vida de Tayrink Ludmilla Cruz conmocionó a la comunidad.

programme.title: Evidencias del Crimen
programme.desc: El 31 de marzo de 2003, los bomberos fueron llamados a un incendio en una urbanización de Meyrargues, cerca de Aix-en-Provence.

programme.title: Mapas de Asesinatos
programme.desc: El asesino en serie más famoso de la historia, el hombre que asesinó a cinco mujeres en las calles de Whitechapel... y se salió con la suya.

programme.title: Casos Sin Resolver
programme.desc: El 2 de abril de 2008, Olivier Arnaud, de 30 años, fue asesinado a sangre fría en plena calle con dos balas de 9 mm disparadas a quemarropa por un hombre encapuchado en una motocicleta.

programme.title: Contra Reloj
programme.desc: El escalofriante secuestro de Sullivan Terneis dejó a Roubaix conmocionada y sin poder creerlo. En medio de conflictos familiares y venganzas personales, la verdad seguía siendo esquiva.

programme.title: Evidencias del Crimen
programme.desc: El 18 de junio de 2011, Marie-Jeanne Meyer, de 17 años, se despidió de su hermana pequeña antes de salir para su trote diario en las alturas de Tournon en Ardèche.

programme.title: Mapas de Asesinatos
programme.desc: La verdadera historia de los asesinatos de Whitechapel como nunca antes se había escuchado.

programme.title: Casos Sin Resolver
programme.desc: El 22 de octubre de 2004, en Chassieu (Ródano), Christiane Commeau, de 54 años, sale a hacer la compra por la mañana, vuelve a su casa, deja las bolsas en su domicilio y baja al aparcamiento de su residencia para guardar el auto.

programme.title: Ási Se Escriben Un Crimen

programme.title: Curandero
programme.desc: Un drama psicológico sobre un talentoso neurocirujano que salva vidas. Como resultado de los celos de su mejor amigo, el protagonista se encuentra en una situación trágica que cambia radicalmente la vida. El neurocirujano Pavel Andreev regresa a un hospital en San Petersburgo tras años en el extranjero. Su mentor, Semenov, le revela que tiene un tumor avanzado. Pavel conoce a su hija, Marina, y promete operarlo.

programme.title: Curandero
programme.desc: Semenov pone a Pavel en las operaciones más complejas, lo que genera tensiones con sus colegas. Pavel y Marina inician un romance y él le propone matrimonio. En una cirugía televisada, Pavel brilla, pero es secuestrado.

programme.title: Curandero
programme.desc: Pavel es golpeado y enviado en un tren a un destino desconocido. Marina y Sergey intentan encontrarlo. Pavel, dado por muerto, despierta en un bosque y llega a una aldea sin recuerdos de su pasado.

programme.title: Curandero
programme.desc: Mientras Marina sigue su búsqueda, Semenov se deteriora y Sergey decide operarlo. Un anciano y una médica rural cuidan de Pavel, quien no recuerda quién es.

programme.title: Curandero
programme.desc: Pavel muestra un talento innato para la medicina en la aldea. Marina contrata un detective para encontrarlo. Semenov descubre que su operación fue fallida.

programme.title: Curandero
programme.desc: Se revelan secretos del pasado de Alexei, el hombre con quien confunden a Pavel. Marina encuentra pistas sobre los secuestradores de Pavel. Sergey sigue involucrado con criminales.

programme.title: Curandero
programme.desc: Marina se acerca a los responsables del secuestro de Pavel. En la aldea, Pavel recibe un pasaporte con el nombre de Alexei, pero tiene dudas sobre su identidad.

programme.desc: Pavel conoce al hijo adoptivo de su antigua novia, lo que reaviva preguntas sobre su pasado. Mientras tanto, Marina investiga la conexión entre un cirujano y criminales.

programme.title: Curandero
programme.desc: Pavel realiza una operación sin autorización en la aldea. Marina empieza a sospechar que él podría ser el misterioso cirujano que trataba a criminales.

programme.title: Curandero
programme.desc: Pavel planea llevar a un niño enfermo a un centro médico en San Petersburgo. Marina descubre pruebas que confirman sus peores sospechas.

programme.title: Curandero
programme.desc: Pavel es obligado a operar en contra de su voluntad. Marina casi abandona la búsqueda, pero un informe de televisión la guía hacia la aldea.

programme.title: Curandero
programme.desc: Marina llega a la aldea y encuentra a Pavel, pero un criminal ataca y mata al anciano que lo cuidó. Pavel decide regresar a San Petersburgo

programme.desc: Pavel vuelve al hospital, pero sigue sin recuperar la memoria. Marina descubre que su padre está en fase terminal y culpa a Pavel por no haberlo salvado.

programme.desc: La operación del niño enfermo es un éxito. Pavel intenta recuperar su memoria con un tratamiento arriesgado. Marina sigue tras la mafia médica.

programme.title: Ángel
programme.desc: Pyotr y Ksenia se aman desde hace años y sueñan con formar una familia justo cuando terminan sus estudios. Pero el padre de Ksenia, dueño de una constructora, es acusado de lavado de dinero a gran escala y podría perderlo todo, incluida su libertad. Entonces aparece Grigory Dmitrievich, un viejo conocido de la familia con poder en la administración local, dispuesto a salvarlo... a cambio de una sola condición: que Ksenia se case con su hijo Dima, un joven que estudia pintura.

programme.title: Ángel
programme.desc: Veinte años después, la familia del artista Dmitri llega a una ciudad costera de vacaciones con Ksenia y su hija Rita. Al recibir una invitación a la reunión escolar, Ksenia no puede negarse: en el fondo, muere por ver de nuevo a Piotr. Pero es Rita, de 19, quien se cruza primero con él, rescatada por Piotr de un peligro. Ahora periodista y editor respetado, con una historia explosiva sobre corrupción en antiguas propiedades del partido, Piotr empieza a sentir atracción por la joven.

programme.title: Ángel
programme.desc: Ksenia le exige a Piotr que se aleje de Rita, pero él no piensa repetir el error de dejar ir a su gran amor: está decidido a luchar por ella. Rita responde igual de firme: no renunciará a Piotr por sus padres. Mientras crece el escándalo de las casas estatales, Edik, colega de Piotr, descubre que intervienen su teléfono, vinculado a la élite política. La amenaza se vuelve real cuando dos desconocidos irrumpen en la redacción exigiendo el expediente, o la familia de Piotr pagará el precio.

programme.title: Ángel
programme.desc: Por seguridad, Pyotr decide que Rita debe quedarse con sus padres, y logra una tregua temporal con Ksenia. Pero cuando entrega su artículo para la próxima edición, órdenes "desde arriba" retiran toda la tirada acusándolo de difamación. Dmitri, sin renunciar a separar a la pareja, se reúne con Aleksandr, el exnovio de Rita e instructor del centro náutico, y le da su bendición para reconquistarla... con una condición: deshacerse de Pyotr.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Camila insiste en saber sobre su relación familiar, piensa que pueda ser prima de Max. Ezequiel quiere despejar la duda de que podría ser su sobrina, interroga a la Madre Isabel que niega saberlo y también recurre a Marcelina que se lo confirma. Camila, protege a Chantal, una niña que vende flores.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje

What does she say was her role in the brutal slayings? And, Erin’s father, Terry, says he has forgiven his daughter -- will her revelations to Dr. Phil cause him to have a change of heart?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: What would you do if you had a sneaking suspicion that your partner was unfaithful, but you couldn’t prove it? Elizabeth and Shawn say they’re at the breaking point in their marriage because Elizabeth thinks her husband is cheating on her. Shawn says he has nothing to hide, and the biggest issue in their relationship is Elizabeth’s lack of trust. Recently, Elizabeth received a phone call in the middle of the night from a man who accused Shawn of sleeping with his wife. How does Shawn respond? Then, the accused husband says he’s willing to take a polygraph test to prove his innocence. Find out what happens when Dr. Phil offers to provide the test backstage. Will Elizabeth’s fears be allayed, or does she have a reason to be skeptical of her spouse?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Cheating, lying and sexual misconduct. Although public figures from John Edwards to Tiger Woods have admitted to this behavior, how would you handle accusations of infidelity in your own relationship? Tingle says she can’t trust her husband, Hermann. She says he lied about how many times he’d been married, and when she discovered he was registered on a singles dating site, he told her that he was doing research for a friend! She says she’s also suspicious of her spouse’s low sex drive and fears he may be getting his needs met elsewhere. Hermann says he wants to regain his wife’s trust but says he can’t handle her insecurity. Should Tingle give him another chance or kick him to the curb? And, when Elizabeth was last on the show, she wanted to know once and for all if her husband, Shawn, was being unfaithful. Find out why Shawn initially agreed to take a polygraph test but later declined. Can this relationship be saved?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Tony Fort was just 10 years old when he says a man his mother trusted to watch him began grooming him, brainwashing him, and sexually abusing him. Tony says he was vulnerable and lonely, and he believed the older man was his best friend. Tony claims the man gave him dangerous, addictive drugs, telling him it was candy, and videotaped Tony being sexually abused. The man even followed Tony’s family when they moved to a new state, and he eventually abducted Tony. Authorities say they believe he had a sinister and dark plan for the little boy. Today, Tony speaks out for the first time about what happened to him.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Tony Fort, a young man who was abducted by a family friend when he was 11 years old, reunites two decades later with the FBI agent that he says saved his life. Go inside the dramatic rescue of Tony from a convicted sex offender. Plus, Alicia Kozak says she was just 13 when she was lured from her home by an internet predator and placed in a dog collar, chained to the floor, and horrifically abused. Hear her inspiring story of survival.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil explores a disturbing trend: Female teachers engaging in sex acts with their underage male students. The number of accusations has doubled in the past five years. You've probably heard of famous cases like Mary Kay Letourneau, Debra Lafave and the recent case of a teacher in Southern California, Meredith Johnson Vincent, who was arrested on suspicion of having a sexual relationship with a 14-year-old boy. Dr. Phil meets one teacher who has chosen to fight back.

programme.title: Dr. Phil

Hear both sides of this gripping sex scandal from the accuser and the accused, and judge for yourself if justice has been served.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: On March 2, 2012, 19-year-old Jacob “Jake” Limberios was fatally shot in the head in the presence of three friends. The coroner ruled his death a suicide -- but Jake’s parents, Mike and Shannon, say it doesn’t add up. They claim there was no investigation into Jake’s death, no evidence collected and no autopsy performed before Jake's death was ruled a suicide -- and they refuse to believe their son would take his own life. Jake’s family say a lot of questions remain unanswered, including: Who fired the shot? Two witnesses, Brittany and Will, adamantly maintain that Jake accidentally shot himself, but Mike and Shannon say their son knew how to handle guns safely and that the evidence doesn’t support that conclusion. Mike takes Dr. Phil cameras to the scene of the shooting to demonstrate why he believes that Jake was shot by someone else in the room. And, Brittany and Will face Mike and Shannon on Dr. Phil’s stage in an attempt to clear the cloud of suspicion that they say still follows them as a result of Mike and Shannon’s allegations. When offered a chance to take a polygraph test, will they accept? Don’t miss this compelling two-part mystery.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The family of 19-year-old Jake Limberios continues to search for answers surrounding his death in March 2012. Who fired the gunshot that ended his life? Brittany and Will, who witnessed the shooting, say Jake, a gun enthusiast, accidentally shot himself in the head. Although the coroner ruled his death a suicide, Jake’s parents, Mike and Shannon, say their son, a young father, never would’ve taken his own life. Left with so many unanswered questions, Jake’s parents had his body exhumed and autopsied by renowned forensic pathologist Dr. Cyril Wecht, who concluded that Jake’s cause of death wasn’t suicide. Dr. Phil speaks with Dr. Wecht via satellite -- hear why he says Jake couldn’t have shot himself. Plus, Brittany and Will say they sympathize with Jake’s parents but are tired of being under suspicion and agree to take polygraph tests to prove they’re not hiding any details about Jake’s death. What will the results reveal? And, Mike and Shannon say their marriage has grown strained since their son’s death -- can they learn to come together and find peace after such a painful loss?

Sammie says her controlling mother and sheltered upbringing are the real problems - but, can she explain the bruises on her body? Then, Samantha is a teen who was blinded by her love affair with her allegedly abusive boyfriend, Aaron. But Corryn says Jack plays games with her and lures her to him every time. Cristie and Jack’s mom, Brytt, say they’ve had it and want their teens’ relationship to end today -- but what does Corryn have to say about that? Can she stop obsessing over Jack, and will she keep a promise she made to Dr. Phil?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Some believe self-censorship is a big problem today, particularly in light of the idea that someone can be "canceled" for their words -- blocked from having a prominent public platform or career for sharing their opinion. Dr. Phil interviews Nate, a former Idaho police officer, who claims he was fired after making a TikTok video about NBA superstar LeBron James that went viral and has been viewed over 4 million times. Nate explains how the fall-out from the video affected him and his family, too. Dr. Phil also speaks with conservative political commentator Tomi Lahren, who says she recently had to be protected by state police from student protestors at the University of New Mexico. Greg Lukianoff, president of the Foundation for Individual Rights and Expression, says he believes Americans have lost the ability to discuss their differences rationally. And, Dr. Shaun Harper, founder and Executive Director of the USC Race and Equity Center, says he is firmly against hate speech and feels people need to be more mindful about the effects of their words.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The “self-censorship” debate continues. Meet Alejandro, a student who claims administrators at his community college violated his free speech rights. He says when he and members of the club Young Americans for Freedom posted flyers on campus, they were censored. Then, which public figures are fighting back against cancel culture? And, Dr. Phil takes a closer look at a list of terms that are now allegedly off limits. What words are on that list? Tune in to find out.

programme.desc: This Dr. Phil Family is angry, out of control, and about to get an intervention in The Dr. Phil House. Melissa, 22, wrote to Dr. Phil for help for her self-destructive family. Her mother, Myra, and her stepfather, Gene, have a long history of betrayals, infidelity, anger and years of bitter resentment. Melissa says her family even turns special occasions into volatile disasters with turkey dinners and Christmas trees being thrown across the room. The fighting got so bad, Melissa says she had to move away from her extreme family. Her brothers, Edwin, 20, and Eugene, 17, attest that their home is a war zone, and that they have witnessed fights between their parents that involve name-calling, spitting and dousing each other with water, all in front of their 7-year-old brother. Myra says she can’t forgive Gene for his four affairs, but especially the last one, which was with a 19-year-old. Over three years have passed since Gene’s last affair, but Myra still calls him a pedophile every chance she gets, and says she’d leave if it weren’t for their youngest child. Can this family learn to stop the drama, heal their anger and start over with a healthy foundation, or should they call it quits for good?

programme.title: BarryTiger
programme.desc: BarryTiger es una serie animada en 3D vibrante y cautivadora, diseñada para niños de 1 a 8 años, que da vida a aventuras cotidianas a través de música pegajosa y encantadora. Con una variedad de personajes coloridos y temas ricos y diversos, la serie muestra los momentos alegres de la vida de la familia BarryTiger. La producción musical de alta calidad, con melodías excepcionales, arreglos sobresalientes y actuaciones destacadas, añade una capa extra de diversión a las escenas animadas y dinámicas. ¡Prepárate para cantar, bailar y explorar junto a Barry y sus amigos en cada emocionante episodio!

programme.title: Domi Kids
programme.desc: "Domi Kids es una serie musical animada en 3D que da vida a las alegres y cálidas aventuras diarias de la familia Domi, compuesta por cinco integrantes. Con música animada y divertida, y actuaciones de múltiples personajes, el programa ofrece una gran variedad de temas, historias atractivas y escenas diversas. Un equipo profesional de producción musical asegura melodías de primera calidad, arreglos excepcionales y actuaciones vocales destacadas, brindando un festín audiovisual encantador para los niños. El contenido es positivo, entretenido y está diseñado para ayudar a los niños a aprender y explorar el mundo de una manera apropiada para su edad. Además, apoya a los padres en su camino hacia una crianza fácil y placentera, mientras acompaña a los niños en su crecimiento y desarrollo."

programme.title: Papelitos
programme.desc: La serie animada “papelitos” cuenta de una manera divertida a los más pequeñitos sobre las simpáticas aventuras de unos animales de papel: Un alce llamado Aristóteles y un pájaro carpintero llamado Tuc-Tuc en el país de papel donde todo por completo está hecho de papel. Divertidas aventuras se acompañan con interesantes clases de manualidades donde los espectadores aprenderán como con papel y cartón crear a todos los personajes de la serie utilizando tijeras y pegamento. El proyecto tiene apoyo de la página web donde están presentados todos los moldes y consejos para crear el mundo de papel. De esta manera el espectador participa en el juego que supone la creación y el desarrollo de muchas habilidades prácticas que distraen a los chicos del encierro permanente de la computadora. El proyecto “Papelitos” es una divertida y didáctica alternativa en lugar de pasar tiempo con la computadora. Toda la acción en el dibujo animado es narrada por una voz en off y repleta de ingeniosos chistes. Cada capítulo dura 5 minutos (la versión sin clase – 4 minutos). La técnica de animación – gráficos 3D que imitan al papel.

programme.title: BFF
programme.desc: Las BFF son un grupo de amigas adolescentes que descubren que juntas pueden superar cualquier situación por complicada que sea y convertirse en… ¡mejores amigas para siempre! Sus aventuras están llenas de momentos musicales y situaciones desternillantes interrumpidas constantemente por Shadow, un personaje mágico y travieso que intenta difundir desesperadamente negatividad y “malas vibraciones”. Sin embargo, ¡sus intentos se verán frustrados por las BFF y sus collares de la amistad!

programme.desc: Eight of the best and most exciting featherweights on the planet go head-to-head in a one-night tournament. GLORY featherweight champion Petch (170-40-3, 27 KO) goes up against former RISE champion Taiju Shiratori (30-10-1, 12 KO), the in-form Berjan Peposhi (30-4, 16 KO) takes on ‘The Korean Monster’ Sunghyun Lee (69-11-2, 17 KO), the always exciting Abraham Vidales (16-3, 13 KO) collides with current RISE champ Chadd Collins (63-17-2, 32 KO), and number one ranked GLORY featherweight Miguel Trindade (59-6, 24 KO) faces RISE great & former GLORY title contender Kento Haraguchi (26-4-1, 17 KO).

programme.title: K1
programme.desc: K-1 World Grand Prix 2003 Final Elimination was a kickboxing event promoted by the K-1 organization. The event was held at the Osaka Dome in Osaka, Japan on Saturday, October 11, 2003 in front of 31,700 spectators. It was the final elimination competition for the K-1 World Grand Prix 2003, involving fourteen fighters from across the world, with all bouts being fought under K-1 Rules (100 kg/156-220 lbs). The fourteen fighters were a mixture of invitees or had qualified via previous events.

programme.title: K1
programme.desc: K-1 World Grand Prix 2003 Final was a kickboxing event promoted by the K-1 organization. The event was held at the Tokyo Dome in Tokyo, Japan on Saturday, December 6, 2003 in front of 67,320 spectators. It was the eleventh K-1 World Grand Prix final involving ten of the world's best fighters (two being reservists). The eight finalists had almost all qualified via preliminary events, while two additional fighters were invited as reserve fighters (for more detail on this see bulleted list below), with all bouts being fought under K-1 Rules (100 kg/156-220 lbs).

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: GLORY 98 features the highly anticipated return of Jamal Ben Saddik (36-9, 29 KO) against the Estonian powerhouse Uku Jürjendal (20-9, 16 KO). In the co-main event of the evening, GLORY Welterweight World Champion Chico Kwasi (43-5-1, 23 KO) is set to defend his title against number two ranked welterweight Teodor Hristov (18-3, 7 KO). Meanwhile, two of 2024’s best prospects will clash as Cem Caceres (18-1, 14 KO) faces Mory Kromah (31-2-1, 18 KO).

programme.desc: With his friend Sébastien Deraspe, Charles-Antoine Crête has fallen under the spell of a self-sufficient home in the Eastern Townships. And while ecological projects begin to take shape one by one, his restaurant, Montréal Plaza, is thriving.

programme.title: PIQUE ASSIETTE S09
programme.desc: Special gnocchi, in all colours. Still accompanied by Nathalie Devantay, Annick Jeanmairet offers black and white gnocchi with cockles. Discovery of the day: cholera cake, a surprising quiche from Upper Valais.

programme.title: CUISINE D'ISABELLE ET RICARDO S02 (LA)
programme.desc: Salad takes center stage. Served with grilled beef, zucchini and corn, or made with halloumi and roasted sweet potatoes, there's something for everyone.

programme.title: Epicerie Fine S08
programme.desc: "Entre Loire et Normandie, Pascal Gasnier produit du cidre et des légumes ; Antoine Debray se consacre au maraîchage. Rencontre avec Mireille Rosenberger, membre de la Société mycologique loupéenne et du Club mycologique de la forêt de Senonches. Visites de la tourbière des Froux, en compagnie de Benjamin Gouraud."

programme.title: SAUVE MA RECETTE
programme.desc: Your banana bread is completely stuck to the cake tin? Don't panic, the team has lots of ideas to save your dessert, all in under ten minutes.

programme.title: LES ROUTES DU GOÛT - LA BALLADE D'EMMA
programme.desc: Michelin-starred chef Alain Llorca, at the head of the restaurant bearing the chef's name, guides a gastronomic route between La Colle-sur-Loup, Nice, Saint-Paul-de-Vence and Tourrettes-sur-Loup. Family encounters, local producers, young talents. The chef shares a passion for generous cuisine rooted in terroir and seasonality.

programme.title: CHEF EN TERRE INCONNUE (UN) / AUTRES DISTRIBUTEURS CANADIENS
programme.desc: In addition to building an extension with a tyre-foundation system in Abercorn, Charles-Antoine and Sébastien learn about Earthship principles by visiting Jean-Nick Trudel's home in Saint-Élie-de-Caxton. They also take the opportunity to enjoy a gourmet stop.

programme.title: PIQUE ASSIETTE S09
programme.desc: Agités du bocal: lacto-fermentation and pickles. Accompanied by Nathalie Devantay, Annick Jeanmairet shares the secrets of lacto-fermentation and pickles. Discovery of the day: Manon's cheese platters, a young cheesemaker from Vaud who won the cheese platter prize at the Swiss Cheese Awards, with platters composed like works of art.

programme.title: CUISINE D'ISABELLE ET RICARDO S02 (LA)
programme.desc: The chef revisits the iconic fish and chips in sandwich form. A practical meal that works for lunch or dinner.

programme.title: Epicerie Fine S08
programme.desc: "Rencontres avec Jérémie Clerc, pêcheur dans les eaux du lac, et avec Mélanie Weber, vigneronne passionnée. Visite de l'insolite château de Chillon. Dans le cadre de la lutte contre les espèces invasives qui polluent le Léman : arrachage de la renouée du Japon et sensibilisation autour de la moule quagga."

programme.title: SAUVE MA RECETTE
programme.desc: You have accidently drowned your noodles in soya sauce? Luckily, the three presenters are there to transform this mistake into an excellent accompaniment.

programme.title: TRES TRES BONNE LECON (LA)
programme.desc: How to open an oyster? Steak tartar: should you use a mincer or a knife? Approved by leading professionals, François-Régis Gaudry offers some seriously good tips for foodies.

programme.title: LES ROUTES DU GOÛT - LA BALLADE D'EMMA
programme.desc: An intimate and gourmet meeting in the heart of Campania. Michelin-starred chef Alfonso Iaccarino opens the doors of Don Alfonso 1890, a temple of Mediterranean cuisine, where a family tradition spanning five generations continues. An opportunity to taste cuisine deeply rooted in terroir.

programme.title: CHEF EN TERRE INCONNUE (UN) / AUTRES DISTRIBUTEURS CANADIENS
programme.desc: In Abercorn, the natural pond has progressed nicely and new trees have been planted on the property. At Montréal Plaza, we gain a better understanding of how Charles-Antoine's creative spirit comes to life in the kitchen and through his connection with local producers.

programme.title: PIQUE ASSIETTE S09

programme.title: CUISINE D'ISABELLE ET RICARDO S02 (LA)
programme.desc: For those who want to get ahead on weekly meals, Isabelle shares a special spaghetti sauce recipe, perfect for freezing.

programme.title: Epicerie Fine S08
programme.desc: "Rencontre avec Nicolas Bucher, éleveur de vache montbéliarde, et avec Nathalie Vernerey, cheffe de culture maraîchère aux Jardins d'idées. Le phytomanagement au Living Lab de Vieux-Charmont, avec Michel Chalot, professeur d'université et biologiste en environnement. « Pas si bêtes », avec Thibaut Seguin, animateur à La Damassine."

programme.title: SAUVE MA RECETTE
programme.desc: Using salt instead of sugar in a cake mix is a mistake that can happen to the best of us. Chloée, Chef Oli and Christian show us clever, anti-waste recipes to save our baking and our taste buds!

programme.title: CHEF EN TERRE INCONNUE (UN) / AUTRES DISTRIBUTEURS CANADIENS
programme.desc: Charles-Antoine's father comes for a visit with a very special gift. This year, the Montréal Plaza staff party takes place in Abercorn. It is an opportunity to move forward with the tyre foundations for the garage.

programme.desc: Simone, a married woman battling anxiety and the lingering shadow of her past alcoholism, escapes to collect her thoughts. programme.title: The Struggle
programme.desc: A story about Debra and her daughter, Tracey struggling in the heart of Memphis. Debra tries to keep her daughter out of danger and off the streets but it doesn't help with the surrounding of drug dealers, pimps and prostitution. It gets worst when Erin and her gang interfere in situations with Tracey and Kandi. That's when Tracey takes matters in her own hands.

programme.title: The Struggle 2: The Dilemma
programme.desc: Darnell gets released from jail and tries to take back control of his territory. Now that Tracey has left and moved to Atlanta with her mom...her sister Stacey is seeking revenge.

programme.title: The Queens Ball
programme.desc: Racine Robinson is the queen pin of a criminal empire, alongside her daughters Cand and Kat. Racine is celebrating her 50th birthday and invited all the regional crime families to come and celebrate. Unbeknownst to her, a contract has been taking out to kil Racine on her birthday. With government intervention, and various talking heads, the death of Racine could lead to open warfare in the city.

programme.title: The Housekeeper
programme.desc: After the death of her son, Sharease Smalls loses everything, and is forced to move back in with her sister Elise. Struggling to find steady work, Sharease agrees to become a live-in housekeeper for a local crime boss, Zues. The pairs professional relationship soon turns intimate, but it’s only a veil of secrets and lies. Will Sharease survive the truth?

programme.title: The Comeback
programme.desc: Jeff and Tisa Murray have decided to move their family back to their hometown of Atlanta when Tisa is offered her dream job. The dream becomes a hilarious reality when family issues, Mom's new boyfriend, and ex-lovers are waiting on them upon their return.

programme.title: The New Girl
programme.desc: When her sister Monica suddenly disappears under suspicious circumstances, Malorie becomes convinced that Monica’s seemingly perfect husband is hiding something sinister. She then launches her own investigation and unearths a twisted web of lies, abuse, and even political conspiracy. Malorie must confront dangerous secrets that not only threaten her sister’s life but her own.

programme.title: His Masterpiece
programme.desc: Victoria and Richard are divorced spouses that operate an art gallery together. After meeting young artist Daniel at a community event, they decide to collaborate with him on the exhibit to generate income for their tax obligations. However, Richard's aggressive nature and ulterior motives soon come to light, leading to a dangerous jealousy within him.

programme.title: Blowback
programme.desc: Former Navy SEAL Ares Sterling, a family man with a dark past, lives peacefully until his wife Lisa is kidnapped after a home invasion. Desperate, Ares seeks help from his estranged father, King, a crime boss he blames for his tragic childhood. Ares revisits the shadows of his past, becoming ruthless to save Lisa and protect his daughter from similar loss, uncovering shocking secrets along the way.

programme.title: If I Can't Have You
programme.desc: Marc, a married man embarks on an affair with the seductive and enigmatic Marissa, that quickly turns into a nightmare. Lust quickly evolves into obsession when she realizes that Marc will never leave his wife. Marissa embarks on a deadly campaign of jealousy and deceit, leaving only destruction in her wake following the mantra "If I can't have you, no one else can." Marc must protect his family, while also confronting the darkest corners of his past that will define the course of his life.

programme.title: Receipts
programme.desc: Meeko, a high-level drug dealer, has built a thriving operation and a reputation to match. But when his supplier is suddenly killed and his entire network collapses, his supply chain runs dry with no chance of recovery. As a means to pivot, he resorts to a new business venture – blackmail.

programme.title: It's Complicated AF
programme.desc: After an intense romance, Ryan and Quaves make the crazy decision to get married without having met in person. But as friends and family gather in Houston for a whirlwind wedding weekend, everything spirals into chaos as the bridal party clashes over secret agendas, bruised egos, and a stolen parking spot. A romantic comedy about fate, bad timing, and the kind of love that refuses to show up quietly.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Thinking a treasure is to be found, Gargamel follows the Smurfs every step: into Jack Frost's cave, then to the desert in search of the Pyramid of Zenobia, and in the West Wind's lair... The Smurfs must find the four elements of the long life Stone before sundown. But can it be done? Can the Smurfs preserve their very existence?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: While the Smurfs left at the Village try to find Grandpa Smurf's box and survive a flood caused by a geyser, Grandpa himself, Papa Smurf, Sassette and a few Smurfs more try to secure the last missing element from a volcano guarded by the terrifying wooden Tikis... and Gargamel, with Azrael as usual, do their best to foul things up for the Smurfs.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: As if Gargamel didn't have enough troubles as it is. Now he is saddled with a new problem, a problem by the name of Scruple, a new apprentice. A lazy, insolent, good-for-nothing character who will help in getting hold of the enchanted quill, a magic pen that writes nothing but the truth... and is going, or so Gargamel hopes, to aid in catching the Smurfs.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Snappy doesn't always do as he is told. For instance, he is a little careless in putting out the campfire where the Smurfs have been roasting marshmallows. Even though the Smurfs are doing the impossible in trying to save the forest from the holocaust, the situation looks bleak. Snappy is hunted by remorse. And he would be even more so if he knew what the evil Gargamel is up to.

programme.title: Can't Smurf The Music
programme.desc: There is nothing the sorceress Chlorhydris hates so much as love in the world. She would like to see all love banished from the face of the Earth, and she's going to start with music. She puts a spell on a magic horn so that it will suck the music out of every song... especially the Smurfs' songs. Helped by their friend Laconia, the Smurfs may be able to resist Chlorhydris' evil plan...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The evil wizard Gargamel has got hold of magical ectoplasmic crystal eggs that will enable him to change bodies with Papa Smurf. What better plan could there be? Disguised as Papa Smurf, he's going to lead all the Smurfs to his cauldron! But as fate would have it, Gargamel is changed into Puppy, the Smurf doggie...

programme.title: Farmer's Genie
programme.desc: As Farmer Smurf says, what's a gourd doing in the melon patch, when it should be by the rutabagas? But when Farmer Smurf pulls the gourd out of the ground he frees a genie, which calls him Master and insists on granting him wishes. The genie, called Gourdy, is going to be more of a hindrance than a help in his eagerness to please Farmer Smurf.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: It's not every day you meet a talking flower. Especially not a character like Petaluma, a somewhat haughty bulb flower who Smurfette meets in the forest. Of course the delighted Smurfette takes Petaluma to the Village of the Smurfs... and starts a process that is going to endanger all of the Smurfs. Flowers, it seems, ought to be seen and not heard.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Everybody can make a mistake. Take Papa Smurf, for instance. His new perfume-enhancing spray makes a rose smell like a thousand roses...but due to a whole series of misadventures it also makes all the Smurfs cry, moved to tears by the slightest of pretexts. While they sob, bawl, wail moan and whimper, the evil wizard Gargamel does not stand still...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Tonight is talent show night in the Village of the Smurfs. Grandpa Smurf is going to do magic tricks, Sassette is going to perform with her trained pet frog, Clumsy is going to try his hand at juggling... and Jokey Smurf has made a dummy of Gargamel that he is sure will frighten the Smurfs out of their wits. But the real Gargamel finds a way to animate Jokey's dummy and then...

programme.title: Smurf On The Run
programme.desc: Little things can sometimes bring about big effects. In trying to catch Sassette, Gargamel upsets the Balance of Truth, and from then on everybody in the world tells lies. Even Papa Smurf is changed into a pathological liar. What is more, the Spirit of the Scales chain Gargamel and Sassette to each other, and together they have to replace the Topaz of Truth....

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Baby Smurf has lost all interest in toys. Even Jokey's surprises fail to amuse the tiny tyke. Grandpa Smurf suggests they go and pay a visit to the Toymaker, the one who makes toys for children all over the world. Or rather used to make: the Toymaker is tired of the lack of appreciation his toys receive from those who receive them.

programme.title: Handy's Window-Vision
programme.desc: Miner Smurf leaves no stone unturned and this is how he discovers a crystal that transmits images. Thus Handy is able to invent window-vision and, every morning from then on, the Smurfs are able to watch Hefty's workouts, Farmer Smurf's crop reports or even the Brainy Smurf Hour. But would you believe it? The evil wizard Gargamel takes advantage of this image-watching to catch Smurfs!

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Papa Smurf has been elected Wizard of the Year, and the evil wizard Gargamel is beside himself with jealousy. He will see to it that Papa's powers all disappear. And then, he is sure to catch all the Smurfs and celebrate with a big feast... But now, would Papa Smurf let such a bad thing happen? Surely not, Papa finds a way to foil Gargamel's plan...

programme.title: The Colour Smurf
programme.desc: Spectra is the Colour Fairy, the one whose wheel of colours make all the blues, reds, yellows and greens of the world. She is a friend of Painter Smurf, so when he takes the Smurflings to her home in her absence, the Smurflings fool around with the Colour Wheel... and all the colours disappear from the Earth. What's worse, without colours the Colour Fairy cannot live...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Sweepy the chimney sweep Smurf is not the most popular inhabitant of the Village of the Smurfs. He is rather messy, and the clouds of soot that he makes certainly don't add to his popularity. Only the Smurflings find him great company as he's the only one who can get dirty and not be told off. Yet in their enthusiasm for Sweepy, the Smurflings endanger the Village.

programme.title: Don Smurfo
programme.desc: Everyone has their own dreams. That of Smurfette is to meet the legendary Don Smurfo, the dashing, witty, swashbuckling hero of many an engrossing tale. The Smurfs shrug at this infatuation. But when a real-life Don Smurfo appears in the village and Smurfette snubs them all in favor of the bragging stranger, they take the matter a little more seriously.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: What is in the box that's been found by Jokey Smurf? A cloak belonging to Wizlow the Magician gnome. And what sort of cloak? Jokey learns that it's a cloak of invisibility. Whoever wears it has a great opportunity of playing practical jokes... And guess what havoc an invisible Jokey is able to wreak on the Village. Yet if Wizlow parted with the cloak, there must be a reason...

programme.title: Snappy's Way
programme.desc: Did you know that if you catch a troll, he may grant you one wish? It just happens that Aloysius the Troll gets caught in one of Gargamel's Smurf traps. Snappy Smurf sets him free and as a reward, gets to make all other Smurfs obey his every whim. Now this brings a lot of trouble to the Smurfs, as Smurflings, sometimes, ask for things that are not good for them... or anybody else.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Brainy Smurf is aghast. Sassette cannot read, and thus might be forever prevented from learning the pearls of wisdom collected in his book "Brainy Smurf's quotations"! He tries teaching her how to read. What she can read almost from the start is a formula to make all the books disappear! All the books in the world, including Gargamel's spells and Homnibus' books of remedies!

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: In another Smurf theatrical super-production based – very loosely – on Alexandre Dumas' characters, a masterpiece of the stage is created, with a few lines from Romeo and Juliet thrown in.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs come to the rescue of two children and their grandfather when a mysterious stranger appears and causes their sleigh to crash. Knocking on Gargamel's door for help puts them and the Smurfs in danger…

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Handy has built a very complex Smurf machine that does everything. It proves dangerous when it nearly destroys the village, but comes in useful when, with the help of the other Smurfs, it saves the young prince Gerard's kingdom from the queen aunt Imperia's dastardly intentions.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs discover a fountain of youth that is guarded by a wicked troll, who steals Papa Smurf's magic book. They convince Gargamel to help them and the greedy villain runs to get the water, but manages to fall in with the troll. As the two chase each other all over the countryside, the Smurfs are able to retrieve Papa Smurf's book.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Simon is lost in the forest and in search of his parents. Simon is the son of a couple of giants. The Smurfs try to bring him home, but then Gargamel interrupts the party.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Once in a blue moon, as the legend goes, a baby Smurf is delivered to the Smurfs and everyone in the village becomes attached to the new arrival. But a mistake has been made and the stork returns to take the baby back. Grouchy and Smurfette have become so attached to the baby that the baby is returned.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Papa Smurf's worries make him break into a rash of worrywarts. The only way to relieve him of his bout of indecision-inducing disease is to have him rub the horn of a Wartmonger, a sloppy, slimy, stupid and brutal enemy of the Pussywillow Pixies...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Poor Lazy! All he wants is a good night's rest. But no, all the Smurfs throw a party for him and, what's more, he gets dragged into a silly argument about painting giant Bigmouth's toes a bright tangerine red... It's a long, sleepless night for poor Lazy Smurf!

programme.title: Smurf Box Derby
programme.desc: Handy Smurf makes another invention: the Smurfmobile. Each Smurf has his – or her – customized vehicle and all, or almost all, the Smurfs enjoy a little spin... But then the evil wizard Gargamel gets hold of the idea and starts making trouble for the Smurfs...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: This time, Gargamel's sinister plan works too well. He just wanted a slight flood to drown the Smurfs. But this is almost the end of the world, and the Smurfs have to build an ark to survive... Will Smurfette's friend, the little winged horse, arrive on time?

programme.title: Babes In Wartland
programme.desc: Baby Smurf, playing hide-and-seek, hides in a basket that gets thrown in the river... Baby Smurf floats to the land of the Pussywillow Pixies... But the nasty, stupid Wartmonger reacts strangely to Baby...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The latest invention of both Greedy and Handy Smurf: a soft, refreshing delicacy that they call Smurf cream but that we humans know as ice cream. All would be well if rivalry did not come between the two Smurfs... And if Gargamel did not do his best to be unpleasant!

programme.title: The Bad Place
programme.desc: What is this little moon coming from above? Why, it's a crater-pockmarked globe of mud inhabited by the Grimeys, a family of mud-splattering, mud-eating creatures from out there in the sky. Not all the Smurfs are enthusiastic about the visitors....

programme.title: Beauty Is Only Smurf Deep
programme.desc: Periwinkle, a vain Pixie, is upset when her magic mirror tells her that Vanity is the fairest, not she. Periwinkle kidnaps Vanity, but the rest of the Smurfs come to Vanity's rescue. Periwinkle sees the error of her ways and they become friends.

programme.title: The Smurfomatic Smurfolator
programme.desc: The evil wizard Gargamel still wants to destroy the Smurfs. This time, he sends on the forest the seeds of a creeping weed that is sure to entangle all the Smurfs… But Handy Smurf has devised a smurfomatic smurfolator...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Plotting to rid himself of the Smurfs, Gargamel casts a spell over Bigmouth and disguises himself as a Smurf. Thinking he is a Smurf, Bigmouth nearly succeeds in wrecking everything in the Village of the Smurfs until Papa Smurf comes up with a cure.

programme.title: The Smurfiest Of Friends
programme.desc: Brainy Smurf had one friend: Clumsy Smurf. But poor Clumsy is so, well, clumsy, that Brainy refuses to see him again. So now he is left without anyone willing to listen to him. Maybe Buddy, the good-looking imp met by chance near the Great Oak can be a pal for Brainy....

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: When Gargamel is able to make a flying carpet out of a patchwork quilt, accidents are bound to happen...The result of one accident is that a piece of the flying bedspread is used as Baby Smurf's diaper, with very surprising results...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: At last here is a post worthy of the great Gargamel's talent and experience! At least, that's what the evil wizard thinks as he learns of Prince Theodore's need of a new court magician. The Smurfs are delighted when they see Gargamel and his good-for-nothing apprentice, Scruple, leaving their hovel in the forest. But maybe they are rejoicing too soon. Who knows what peril Gargamel has in store?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Get up early in the morning, before any other Smurf is out of bed, to prepare a scrumptious Smurfberry muffin. Spend all morning on preparing Smurf delicacies for lunch. Than all afternoon to have dinner ready – and delicious – on time. And do you get so much as a thank you form the Smurfs? So Greedy Smurf quits. The Village is in trouble... And soon, so is Greedy.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Yes, there can be too much of a good thing. When an accident happens to Papa Smurf's magic formula and he ends up multiplied by two, the Smurfs are elated: two Papa Smurfs can give twice the good counsel and twice the loving that one can. But after a while, things get too complex in the Village. Especially when another accident doubles the number of Gargamels!

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Greenpeedeepee Swamp is the only place you can find Swamp Root, the delicious and necessary ingredient of Greedy Smurf’s famed swamp root stew. Unfortunately, it is also one place where you can find those hideous Wartmongers. Even though Sassette and the Smurfs save a young Wartmonger’s life, they still end up being captured by the others. But the Scarlet Croaker will save them! Maybe.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: No one believes Grandpa Smurf when he tells of far-away jungles and savannahs teeming with wild giant cats, striped horses, long-necked leaf-eaters and strange tribes... Only some Smurflings give some credit to his tales. But when Grandpa Smurf hears the sound of the magic Royal Drum in the forest, the one that can tame wild beasts, he sets out to prove that he's not an old addle-brained storyteller.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: This is Wild Smurf's first Christmas, and he's impressed by the decorations in the Village of the Smurfs. But Grandpa and Sassette are going to teach him the real meaning of Christmas when they help an old couple to live the most beautiful Christmas they've ever seen...

programme.title: The Horn Of Plenty
programme.desc: Mother Nature always does her best, but this time she's gone wrong. Her wand gets the wrong results and she accidentally damages the Autumn harvest. Now the Smurfs and all the forest animals face a lean and hungry winter. The only place where the Smurfs could get food would be the Land of Plenty. But Gargamel steals the famed Horn of Plenty to lure the Smurfs.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Handy Smurf has hit on a revolutionary new idea: a sort of smurfless carriage that moves on railroad tracks. He calls it a railsmurfer and it makes for less work in the Village... until Gargamel chances upon it.

programme.title: Jokey's Joke Book
programme.desc: Jokey Smurf's joke boxes are no longer funny to the other Smurfs. Jokey finds new ideas in his Great Joke Book, but these ideas are even less popular in the Village. And here comes the evil Gargamel with a few jokes of his own...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Gargamel the evil wizard is in trouble again. If he can't find an enormous amount of gold by sundown, all his possessions will be taken away from him. But the Smurfs are going to help their arch-enemy... Up to a point.

programme.title: Skyscraper Smurfs
programme.desc: Sure, a village of mushroom-shaped houses is nice and jolly... But not very modern, in Architect Smurf's view. What the Smurfs need is smurfdominium, a new, daring concept that will change the art of living forever...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Harmony Smurf is no longer wanted in the Smurf Choir: his singing is too far off-key. But Papa Smurf gives him an amulet that will make him a vocal virtuoso. Now here comes Hogatha...

programme.title: All The News That's Fit To Smurf
programme.desc: Curious Smurf has an idea: why not print a sheet with all the Village news? He's sure to interest all his readers of the Smurf Tattler. But things don't go exactly to plan when Papa finds super smurfberries.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Flighty Smurf, as his name implies, can't make his own mind up about anything. The other Smurfs take him to the forest for a survival test in which he can find his way home only by making decisions. He ends up in Balthazar's castle.

programme.title: Return To Don Smurfo
programme.desc: When a drop of Papa Smurf's new potion spills on the Smurflings' adventure book, the fictional hero springs to life. The dashing Don Smurfo, willing to rid the Smurf of the evil Gargamel, gallantly captures him...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: With Chitter his favourite squirrel mysteriously gone away, Wild Smurf feels very lonely. He haunts the Village despondently and his eyes light up only when Smurfette is about. The other Smurfs notice a sudden interest from Smurfette too...

programme.title: Vanity's Wild Adventure
programme.desc: Vanity Smurf is a finicky dresser; he takes care of his good looks and would do his utmost to avoid the tiniest grain of dust that might soil his attire. Wild Smurf is... Well, he's sort of wild. When both of them spend some time together, sparks fly...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Gargamel, the evil wizard, has come to the somewhat obvious conclusion that if he were a little faster on his feet, he'd be able to catch more Smurfs. He concocts a new formula while, in the Village, the Smurfs are wishing that Wild Smurf could slow down a little bit...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: If there is one thing that the evil sorceress Chlorhydris cannot abide, it is other people's happiness. The spectacle of the Smurfs' gentle and song-filled life gets Chlorhydsis' hackles up. She must destroy that tinkling laughter, smother those happy repartees... She plants the root of evil in the forest and soon, no Smurf is on speaking terms with another. Baby Smurf is the only one untouched...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Winter is setting in on the Village of the Smurfs. The little Smurfs are freezing. But what is Clumsy doing with this strange rock he's discovered? And why is Miner Smurf so enthusiastic about their new discovery? Surely, one more addition to Clumsy's rock collection is not worth all this hoopla... The Smurfs will discover danger and surprises when they go underground.

programme.title: Scruple's Sweetheart
programme.desc: Brenda, the little witch, feels rejected: no-one is taking her to this year's Broomstick Ball. Oh, if she could find some nice-looking boy... Then she meets Scruple, apprentice of the evil wizard Gargamel. He's so handsome, and available too! What she does not know is that Scruple's only interest is her magic wand. What the Smurfs know is that they're going to save the day.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: It's not his fault. Clumsy Smurf never stops causing catastrophes, and even when Papa Smurf sends him to the forest on a single errand, he brings back a cloud of bad luck the shadow of which causes misfortune to anyone – or any Smurf – under it... Papa Smurf is going to need all his resources to find a cure: the silver lining that every dark cloud ought to have!

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Handy learns it’s better to have smurfed than not to have smurfed at all when he learns his true love is really a mermaid. Can they really live with each other forever?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: As the Smurfs busily build a time capsule for all of their talents, Papa Smurf frantically tries to unravel an ancient Druid riddle before disaster strikes the forest.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The wonderful joy of Christmas for Baby Smurf and everyone else is almost ruined by the evil Chlorhydris who puts a spell on Mr. Nicholas to stop him from spreading holiday cheer. Fortunately, Papa Smurf and his little blue creatures break the spell and Christmas spreads over the land once more.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The wicked wizard Gargamel asks the sorcerer Balthazar for a recipe to capture the Smurfs. It involves kidnapping Mother Nature to stop the arrival of Spring. Luckily, the Smurfs save the day.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs discover the spirit and joy of friendly competition when they hold their first "Smurfic Games". After a near miss with the troublesome cat Azrael, the Smurfs decide they need to get into better shape. Papa Smurf suggests that the Smurfs tone their bodies as well as sharpen their athletic abilities by inaugurating the "Smurfic Games".

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: Clumsy Smurf's misadventures take him across a river into Pussywillow Hollow. There he meets the Pixies – charming and shapely beings whose enemies, the Wartmongers, will meet the Smurfs in some unforeseen ways.

programme.title: Remote Lakes, Big Fish, Epic Days
programme.desc: Paul, Perry, and Dan head east of Timmins to the historic waters of Frederick House Lake for a late-season ice adventure under warm, spring-like skies. What starts as a perfect day on the hardwater quickly turns into a multispecies showcase—pike, perch, walleye, and sauger all keep the crew busy as the bite fires up. But as Northern Ontario weather often reminds us, conditions shift fast. With the wind picking up and clouds rolling in, the team wraps up an incredible day and makes their way home, grateful for one more memorable outing before the thaw.

programme.desc: The proud Princess likes to do things her own way, but her antics are always joined by her restless brother, Prince, who tends to turn everything topsy-turvy. Any playtime in their room transforms into a fantastic journey through unusual worlds: the children arrange a picnic on the Moon, conduct a detective investigation in a toy city, or search for pirate treasures on islands! Although initially, the Princess and Prince seem to clash and compete, by the end, they always find joy in each other's company and that of their cherished dog, Bona.

But even masters need to stop and refuel. When meals or snack time interrupt Ollie’s play, he finds himself confronted with the real challenge of childhood; trying new food. programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: After a few incredible days targeting redfish on the inshore waters of Venice, Louisiana, Eric and Moe Newman bring Rush to the nearshore oil rigs — and that’s where things get wild. The rigs are holding GIANT mangrove snapper, bruiser cobia, and hard-fighting jacks… but getting them to the boat is a whole different story. Fishing heavy structure means short strikes, busted hooks, shredded leaders, and fish that know exactly where to run. Around these rigs it’s not just fishing — it’s full-blown combat. If you want to land one of these beasts, you better bring extra hooks, heavy tackle, and a whole lot of patience. Easier said than done. Venice, Louisiana continues to prove why it’s one of the most action-packed fisheries in the country.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: Season 10 is a wrap! Rush takes a moment to look back on some of his favorite moments from battling giant snook and feisty tarpon in Florida, to overnighting at Catalina Island, and chasing bull redfish in Louisiana. This season was all about getting out there with good friends, making new ones, and enjoying the sport we love. An unforgettable year filled with adventure, laughs, and epic days on the water.

programme.title: Winchester Life

programme.title: Winchester Life

programme.title: Winchester Life

Now with Winchesters in hand, both are in the Midwest whitetail woods during late November during the back end of the rut hoping to connect on a Missouri monarch.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Deer season — the sights, the sounds and the smells stick with you. It’s about remembering those who came before us and setting the right example for those who look up to us. programme.desc: In this episode Andy and his son, Logan visit the beautiful country of New Zealand. As well as harvesting the wild game New Zealand has to offer Andy also learns about the importance of the conservation efforts that hunting has in this country from locals in which he spends time with.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In this episode Andy and his friend Scotty take on Kodiak Island, Alaska for an adventure of Salmon fishing and hunting black tail deer. Whilst traversing steep mountains in the company of Kodiak brown bears and taking on cold Alaskan waters, Andy presents useful information for fellow outdoor enthusiasts all whilst building friendships with the great people of Kodiak Big Timber Lodge.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In this episode Andy goes back to his home farm in Alabama for deer and quail hunting. Not only does he make incredible dishes with his former ‘masterchef’ contestant Alex which he serves to local children in need but he explains how hunting is never about “just the hunt” but about the camaraderie, friendship and memories made through the pursuit of the harvest.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In part 1 of the British episodes, Andy starts his road trip around the United Kingdom in the Cotswolds where he sets out to hunt and taste the beautiful venison that Michelin star chef, Mark Robinson has to offer. He then proceeds to travel to the border of Scotland where he samples some of the finest and most historic bird shooting practices found throughout the British Isles.

programme.title: Local Lines
programme.desc: Orange Lake is a bass angler's paradise, known for its enormous trophy bass. On this episode of Local Lines TV, we dive into these rich waters to uncover the secrets of catching these giants. Get ready for thrilling action and expert tips from Brandon Branch and Trevor Fitzgerald.

programme.title: Local Lines

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: Rush teams up with longtime friend and fellow angler Jesus Diaz for a well-earned "busman's holiday" in the beautiful waters of Key West.
